title: HELIX Terminology: Performance Rating
description: Standard performance evaluation ratings used in higher education staff appraisals.

codes.definition: Performance consistently and significantly exceeds expectations. Demonstrates outstanding contributions, innovation, and impact well beyond the scope of the position. Reserved for truly extraordinary performance (typically no more than 5-10% of workforce).
Performance regularly exceeds the requirements of the position. Delivers high-quality work ahead of schedule, takes on additional responsibilities, and contributes beyond assigned duties.

Performance fully meets the requirements and standards of the position. Consistently delivers quality work, meets deadlines, and fulfills all position responsibilities. This is the expected performance level for a competent employee.

Performance meets some but not all position requirements. Some areas need improvement. Typically triggers a performance improvement plan (PIP) with specific goals, timeline (30-90 days), and support resources.
Performance fails to meet minimum requirements of the position despite prior feedback and support. May trigger formal corrective action, reassignment, or termination process. Must be well-documented.
Performance not formally evaluated for this period. Used for new employees in probationary period, employees on extended leave, or positions where evaluation was deferred.
Used following a performance improvement plan (PIP). Employee has shown measurable progress toward meeting expectations but monitoring continues. PIP may be extended or concluded.
